sub_graphs.title: Electra: Deposit Processing Lifecycle
sub_graphs.description: Models the lifecycle of deposits from execution layer requests through pending queue to validator balance updates

nodes.label: Deposit Request Received from Execution Layer
nodes.description: Execution layer has delivered a deposit request via ExecutionRequests container

nodes.label: Validate Deposit BLS Signature
nodes.description: Verify BLS signature on deposit message using is_valid_deposit_signature

nodes.label: Deposit Queued as PendingDeposit
nodes.description: Deposit added to state.pending_deposits list awaiting epoch processing

nodes.label: Process Pending Deposits at Epoch Boundary
nodes.description: Iterate pending_deposits up to MAX_PENDING_DEPOSITS_PER_EPOCH (16), checking finality and churn limits

nodes.label: Deposit Applied to Validator Balance
nodes.description: Validator balance increased, effective balance updated respecting max caps

nodes.label: Deposit Deferred Due to Churn Limit
nodes.description: Deposit remains in pending queue because activation churn limit reached for this epoch

nodes.label: Check Slot Finality Before Processing
nodes.description: Verify deposit slot has been finalized before applying balance changes

edges.label: Execution layer delivers deposit request via ExecutionRequests
Deposit slot is finalized, proceed with processing
Churn limit exceeded, deposit remains pending

external_entities.name: Execution Layer
external_entities.description: Ethereum execution layer delivering deposit requests up to MAX_DEPOSIT_REQUESTS_PER_PAYLOAD (8192)

sub_graphs.title: Electra: Validator Consolidation State Transitions
sub_graphs.description: Models consolidation flow where two validators merge balances, including compounding credential conversion

nodes.label: Consolidation Request Received
nodes.description: Execution layer delivered a consolidation request with source_pubkey and target_pubkey

nodes.label: Validate Consolidation Request
nodes.description: Verify source_address matches withdrawal credentials, both validators active, source != target, and neither slashed

nodes.label: Switch to Compounding Credentials
nodes.description: Change withdrawal_credentials prefix from 0x01 to 0x02 and queue excess balance as pending deposit

nodes.label: Consolidation Pending
nodes.description: PendingConsolidation created with source_index and target_index, awaiting epoch processing

nodes.label: Process Pending Consolidation
nodes.description: Move min(source_balance, source_effective_balance) from source to target validator

nodes.label: Source Validator Exiting
nodes.description: Source validator initiated exit, balance will transfer when withdrawable

nodes.label: Consolidation Complete
nodes.description: Balance transferred, source validator empty, target balance increased

edges.label: Execution layer delivers consolidation request (max 2 per payload)
Source validator exit initiated respecting churn limits
Source is withdrawable, process balance transfer
Balance moved from source to target

external_entities.name: Execution Layer
external_entities.description: Delivers consolidation requests from validator withdrawal addresses

sub_graphs.title: Electra: Attestation and Slashing Validation
sub_graphs.description: Models the validation rules for Electra attestations with committee_bits and updated slashing mechanics

nodes.label: Attestation Received
nodes.description: New-format attestation received with committee_bits bitvector and expanded aggregation_bits

nodes.label: Validate Committee Bits
nodes.description: Verify committee_bits covers valid committee indices within MAX_COMMITTEES_PER_SLOT

nodes.label: Compute Attesting Indices
nodes.description: Iterate committee_bits, extract per-committee portions of aggregation_bits to determine attesting validators

nodes.label: Verify Aggregate BLS Signature
nodes.description: Validate BLS aggregate signature from all attesting validators

nodes.label: Attestation Valid
nodes.description: Attestation passed all validation checks, ready for inclusion

nodes.label: Attester Slashing Detected
nodes.description: Two conflicting attestations from same validator detected

nodes.label: Slash Attester
nodes.description: Apply slashing penalty: effective_balance / MIN_SLASHING_PENALTY_QUOTIENT_ELECTRA (4096)

nodes.label: Attester Slashed
nodes.description: Validator marked slashed, penalty applied, whistleblower rewarded at 1/4096 rate

edges.label: Committee bits valid, compute attesting indices
Conflicting attestation found for same validator

external_entities.name: Validator P2P Network
external_entities.description: Network of validators submitting attestations via gossip

sub_graphs.title: Electra: Withdrawal and Partial Exit Processing
sub_graphs.description: Models the dual withdrawal paths: execution-layer withdrawal requests and automatic partial withdrawals for compounding validators

nodes.label: Withdrawal Request Received from EL
nodes.description: Execution layer delivers withdrawal request with source_address, validator_pubkey, and amount

nodes.label: Validate Withdrawal Request
nodes.description: Verify source_address matches 0x01 withdrawal credentials, validator active and not exiting

nodes.label: Full Exit Requested
nodes.description: Amount is FULL_EXIT_REQUEST_AMOUNT (0), validator will fully exit

nodes.label: Partial Withdrawal Queued
nodes.description: PendingPartialWithdrawal created with specified amount

nodes.label: Compute Exit Epoch with Churn
nodes.description: Calculate exit epoch respecting per-epoch churn limits via exit_balance_to_consume

nodes.label: Validator Exiting
nodes.description: Exit epoch set, validator in exit queue

nodes.label: Process Partial Withdrawals
nodes.description: Sweep up to MAX_PENDING_PARTIALS_PER_WITHDRAWALS_SWEEP (8) partial withdrawals per block

nodes.label: Balance Withdrawn
nodes.description: Partial balance sent to withdrawal address, remaining balance stays with validator

edges.label: Execution layer delivers withdrawal request (max 16 per payload)
Validate withdrawal request credentials and state
Compute exit epoch for full exit

sub_graphs.title: Electra: Churn Limits and Balance Economics
sub_graphs.description: Models the three independent churn tracks that rate-limit balance movements across the validator set

nodes.label: Epoch Churn Limits Initialized
nodes.description: New epoch begins with fresh churn capacity for activation, exits, and consolidations

nodes.label: Compute Balance Churn Limit
nodes.description: Calculate base churn rate from total active balance

nodes.label: Compute Activation/Exit Churn Limit
nodes.description: Cap at min(balance_churn, 256 ETH) for activation and exit churn

nodes.label: Compute Consolidation Churn Limit
nodes.description: Remaining capacity: balance_churn - activation_exit_churn

nodes.label: Deposit Balance to Consume Tracked
nodes.description: deposit_balance_to_consume accumulator tracks remaining activation capacity

nodes.label: Exit Balance to Consume Tracked
nodes.description: exit_balance_to_consume accumulator tracks remaining exit capacity

nodes.label: Consolidation Balance to Consume Tracked
nodes.description: consolidation_balance_to_consume tracks remaining consolidation capacity

edges.label: Base churn used to derive activation/exit cap

ambiguities.text: Eth1 bridge deposits processed before execution-layer deposit requests - the exact ordering and transition point between the two deposit mechanisms is complex.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume deposit_requests_start_index marks a clean cutoff: deposits with index < start_index come from Eth1 bridge, >= from execution layer. This is an assumption.

ambiguities.text: The term 'excess balance' for compounding validators is used in multiple contexts (partial withdrawals, consolidation) with potentially different thresholds.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume excess balance always means balance above MIN_ACTIVATION_BALANCE (32 ETH) for withdrawal eligibility, and balance above get_max_effective_balance for effective balance capping. This is an assumption.

ambiguities.text: The specification does not fully clarify what happens when a consolidation request targets a validator that is already in the exit queue.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume consolidation requests targeting exiting validators are silently dropped during validation. This is an assumption.

implicit_assumptions.description: The execution layer correctly enforces MAX_DEPOSIT_REQUESTS_PER_PAYLOAD, MAX_WITHDRAWAL_REQUESTS_PER_PAYLOAD, and MAX_CONSOLIDATION_REQUESTS_PER_PAYLOAD limits before delivering to consensus layer.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Consensus layer could receive more requests than expected, potentially causing state bloat or exceeding processing limits.

implicit_assumptions.description: Finality is achieved regularly enough that pending deposits do not accumulate to PENDING_DEPOSITS_LIMIT (2^27).
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Extended finality failures could cause deposit queue overflow, blocking new validator activations.

implicit_assumptions.description: An attacker cannot forge withdrawal credential addresses to submit unauthorized withdrawal or consolidation requests.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Unauthorized fund extraction or forced validator consolidation/exit.
